title: •Officer Evax
caption: •Officer Evax (V)
game_text: Imperial Council Member. *Agenda:* logistics. Once per turn, if at Conference Room, may target an opponent’s starship on table with power < total influence here. Opponent must use +2 Force to move target (or initiate battle there) this turn.
lore: This Imperial Intelligence *leader* has a proven track record for predicting Rebel fleet movements. His coordination of starship maneuvers has saved many vulnerable bases.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2 / INFLUENCE 1; deploy 2 / forfeit 5 — the stub's 'deploy=5' is the forfeit (stub error). 'Agenda:' bold (colon too, as on #35). Icon column: one yellow DS pilot icon → pilot (matches col-pilot-dark). Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. The wiki default 'Officer Evax' page is Glossary 2.0 errata; printed face = 'Officer Evax (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set), image ANH-D-officerevax-decipher-archive.gif (350×490 square-on scan, used as src). The 745 px ANH-D-officerevax.gif was also downloaded (src/vs12/40-ANH-D-officerevax.gif) — may be the errata face, art only. Lore corrected from scan: 'leader' is printed bold (visible on both scans). Copyright 1996 by set. Modern: VB4 only (-pre, 350 px).
